what: Gap-fill no-op when finalize-state.sh is missing but stall type is inline-finalized
scenario_or_breakage: _write_terminal_state / in-loop writers can fail after returning STALLED (disk full, permission error) leaving no finalize-state.sh; gap-fill skips because the stall matches merge-cap/pre-rebase/ci-monitor-cap even though STALL_TRACKING was never persisted; Step 18 misclassifies the run
suggested_fix: Drop the missing-file inline-finalized no-op heuristic; gate only on existing finalize-state with STALL_TRACKING=true plus invalid-tmpdir allowlist exclusion
